extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object:

    overlap_side: int

        keep(it.object_length == stationary_object.get_length())

    # Placement of object with respect to Ego
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        ((sut.car.get_width())*overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object*0.01)-
        ((overlap_offset.overlap_offset_coord() + sut.car.get_width())/2)))

    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)

    top.position_along_drive(object_position, vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_side*overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: gen_cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start)


    # Attributing gen variables from subscenario to its father (cut-out main) scenario
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.road == road)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_ego_speed_at_start == gen_ego_speed_at_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_min_lanes == gen_min_lanes)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end)
    

    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event


    # Metrics being covered that are specific from this scenario
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start: length = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_start_event)
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_end: length = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_end_event)
    var exposing_object_pos := sample(object_position.road_position, @start)
    var cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_exposing_object_at_passing_lane_marking: time = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(stationary_object), @cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking)
    var ego_rel_lon_distance_to_object_at_essence_end: length = sample(\
        sut.car.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_end_event)

    const ego_along_start_offset: range of length = [10..20]m

    # Keeping the duration of the essence phase short to avoid cut_out_vehicle impeding ego's maneuvers
    gen_essence_exposing_object_duration: time with:
        keep(default gen_essence_exposing_object_duration in [1..5]s)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_duration_at_essence == gen_essence_exposing_object_duration)
    gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object: time with:
        keep(default gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object in [2..15]s)
    gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object: time with:
        keep(default gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object == gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

        keep(it > gen_cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start + 2*phase_essence_scenario_stopper.ego_bypassing_object_end_distance)
    min_distance_ego_has_to_travel_tolerance: length = 3 * phase_essence_scenario_stopper.ego_bypassing_object_end_distance

        phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object: serial:

                # Call main scenario for vehicle_cut_out 
                vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object: vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle,
                    road: road)

                # The stationary_object is positioned at the start of the scenario
                stationary_object_at_essence_exposing_object: stationary_object.exists_at(object_position) with:
                    intent_stationary_object_rotation_at_essence_exposing_object: rotation(roll: roll_angle_at_essence, yaw: yaw_angle_at_essence, pitch: pitch_angle_at_essence)

            # This is necessary so that the ego can pass the newly exposed stationary_object 
            phase_essence_passing_object: parallel(overlap: equal):
                    drive_ego_at_essence_passing_object: sut.car.drive() with:
                        intent_ego_position_at_essence_passing_object_end: distance(min_distance_ego_has_to_travel, tolerance: min_distance_ego_has_to_travel_tolerance)
                        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_passing_object: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                    drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_passing_object: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_passing_object: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_passing_object: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_passing_object: avoid_collisions(false, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: object_scenario_stopper(object_position: object_position)
    
    on @phase_essence_exposing_object.start:
        cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = false
        call cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()

    on @phase_essence_exposing_object.end:
        cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = true
        call cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()
    
    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override_intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end: override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_at_essence_end: change_lane(outer.number_of_lanes_to_change, side: gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)


extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object_test:
    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
